text_block_list.text:
―A summer training camp to strengthen her 
abilities. This is the perfect chance for 
Haru Urara to get stronger, but…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wow, so much nature! The sky seems so high 
up!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, we're all staying over! I've been 
looking forward to this for so long!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's the sea! I can see a little bit 
of it from here!

… Is she going to be fine? Even though I'm 
a little worried, the summer camp has 
begun!
